The Audit Committee and the Board has approved, the proposal to sell/dispose of the entire investment held in Compulsorily Convertible Preference Shares, i.e., 15.57 percent on a fully diluted basis, of Accelerated Learning Edutech Private Limited, in the meeting held on March 28, 2026.
The actual sale transaction was completed on March 30, 2026. Based on this transaction, the Company has divested its entire 15.57 percent investment, resulting in nil shareholding as of March 31, 2026.
In the Date of Acquisition column, we have mentioned the date on which the Audit Committee and the Board have approved the aforesaid sale transaction, as the disclosure of acquisition sheet does not contain a column for the date of sale.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Company has filed an appeal against Order No. File No. ACCT(Audit) 4.5/ DGSTO-4/S-73-197/25-26 dated 30.12.2025 seeking to set aside the tax, interest and penalty demands imposed under Section 73 of CGST Act / KGST Act, 2017 read with Section 20 of IGST Act, 2017 alleging that non-payment of GST on outward supplies due to incorrect classification of such supplies as zero-rated as per Sec 2(6) of the IGST Act and short payment of taxes under the RCM on inward supply of services under Section 9(3) of the CGST Act.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: There has been no further update since the filing of the appeal on 13.02.2026 as of date.
